text.content:
Early this morning, cultist of the Crimson Hand raided the nearby village of Hillshire, capturing several villagers before disappearing into the night.

Sister Inna, a priestess of St. Terragnis who escaped the attack, hopes to enlist the PCs in rescuing the villagers, especially Father Marcus (a pillar of the community), saying they can keep any of the chapel's treasure recovered from the raiders.

If the PCs pursue the cultists, they can easily track them to their lair, a dark temple carved into the side of a mountain.

The cultists are led by Dark Apostle Moloch, a dangerous and charismatic man, who seeks to bolster his forces by "converting" the strong (through sinister, mind-controlling magic), and sacrificing the rest to his dark god, Ramlaat the Pillager.

Crimson Hand

The Cult seeks the favor of Ramlaat to grow in power before a prophesized apocalypse where only the strongest will survive.

Core Cult Tenants

  • Honor Ramlaat and his Skull Altars with blood.

  • Obey until you can usurp.

  • Only the strong survive.

Cult Ranks

Strict hierarchy, denoted by robe color:

  1. 1 Cult Leader (Black Robe with Gold Trim). Apostle Moloch

  2. 2 Masters (Black Robes). Master-at-Arms and Mistress of Pain

  3. ~12 Acolytes/Hunters (Red Robes). Not allowed in Moloch's Chambers

  4. ~24 Neophytes (Brown Robes). Not allowed east of Great Hall

If PCs disguised as cultists, typically not questioned by cultists of equal or lower rank (unless acting suspicious).

Cultist Temple

Light. Illuminated unless noted. Only Apostle Moloch and Mistress of Pain are dark-adapted

Danger Level. Unsafe. Check every 3 rounds or after loud noises. D6 roll of 1 = encounter.

@UUID[RollTable.vQSJwj4ccjw9kDM7]{Random Encounters}

Rescue the Villagers

  • PCs gain 1 XP per villager rescued (2 XP for Father Marcus)

  • If clear path to exit, can escape without escort.

Blood Lust

  • When afflicted, use next action to attack the nearest creature (with ADV), or take 1d4 damage.

Optional Rules

These optional rules can be used for difficulty scaling.

Fate Worse Than Death

  • Cultist do non-lethal damage unless noted. "Take them alive!"

  • At 0 HP, unconscious until roused (no move or actions).

  • Rouse after combat ends or when healed.

  • Captured PCs wake in Dungeon, no gear (once only, then taken for immediate "conversion").

Blood God's Blessing

Inside temple, killing blows heal you for max HP of creature slain.

No Mere Rabble

PCs get max HP at level 1 and start with a Luck Token (Sister Inna's Blessing)

Large skull statue, covered in bloody handprints. Many hallways.

  • Skull Statue. Trap. Runic inscription.

    • Inscription. "The price of entry is blood, and it shal be paid, one way or another."

    • Trap. Unless place bloody hand on skull before leaving room, aflicted by Blood Lust (see below).

    • Bloody Hand. 1 HP of blood, own or not.

  • Blood Lust

    • When afflicted, use next action to attack the nearest creature (with ADV), or take 1d4 HP damage.

  • Hallways.

    • North. Faint snoring (Barracks)

    • East. Many voices raised in celebration (Great Hall)

    • South. Barking, fearful cries (Kennels)

    • West. Exit.

Sounds of snoring. Door cracked. Dark room.

  • Dark. Total Darkness (requires light to see).

When lit:

  • Sleeping cots and straw cover floor (flammable)

    • Flammable. 1d4 damage/round. Burns for 1d4 rounds.

  • Sleeping figures

    • 6 @UUID[Actor.yguUZJ0iczCebi8e]{Cult Neophyte}

    • 2 @UUID[Actor.uExzKZRMjXZRrhnh]{Cult Acolyte}

    • Melee attacks hit sleepers automatically

  • Piles of gear (by sleepers).

    • Neophytes: Dagger, Brown Robes

    • Acolytes. Leather Armor, Shortsowrd, Red Robes, 1d4 gold

Waking Sleeping Cultist:

  • Sleeping. At 3 infractions, sleeping cultist awake (surprised). Some things may wake them automatically (loud noises, etc.)

  • Infractions

    • Gain 1 for instance of light, noise, failed sneak check (DC 9, DISADV in dark)

    • Gain 2 for each Nat 1 check wile in room.

    • Remove 1 for each round spent silent.

Sound of precise ordes barked by gruff voice. Heavily armored man in black robes, flanked by two brown robed figures, stands over a pit. Muffled sounds of struffle come from within. Racks of shoddy equipement and sparring dummies line the walls.

  • Heavily Armored Man is @UUID[Actor.aunPpSkLC5X1ERt2]{Master-At-Arms}

    • Confrontational. Will question any passing by, even disguised. "How dare you disrupt this sacred contest?"

  • Brown Robed Figures are 2 @UUID[Actor.yguUZJ0iczCebi8e]{Cult Neophyte}

  • Fighting Pit. 10' deep. Rope ladder can be lowerd or pulled up (action)

    • 2 @UUID[Actor.5wDTrsifhahwMDiH]{Strong Villager} forced to duel to death.

    • Fall Damage. 1d6 fall or shoved in.

  • Equipment. Shoddy, but some usable

    • 1 spear, 1 warhammer

    • 2x leather armor and shields

Sound of barking dogs, cruel laughter, cries of fear. Two red robed figures sit at a wooden table, jeering at old woman, cowering in southwest corner of room from emaciated dog chained to south wall. four cages line the west wall, one holds another dog, the rest are empty.

  • Red Robed Figures are 2 @UUID[Actor.1CzjZG3i850scqjZ]{Cult Hunter}

  • Old Woman is a @UUID[Actor.cRu7Vgmf0tDfsGFQ]{Villager}

  • Dogs, starving @UUID[Actor.lMQVYKov4Q7SVRg3]{Mastiff}. Vicious, emaciated.

  • Cages. Fastened shut, can be opened using action.

  • Table. Two potions. Relevant background or testing can identify.

    • Blue Potion. Sleep Potion. If ingested sleep for 1d6 hours. Damage wakes.

    • Red Potion. Healing potion (1d6 HP)

Front Gate. Two brown robed figures stand sentry out front. Distracted, arguing over which is at fault for being on sentry duty instead of celebrating with the others.

  • Brown Robed figures are @UUID[Actor.yguUZJ0iczCebi8e]{Cult Neophyte}

  • Distracted. Unless PCs making significant noise, cultist don't notice their approach.

  • Sentry. If spot danger, neophytes will run to Barracks for aid.

    • To avoid trap in Entrance Hall, will use blood in pouches (action) on Skull Statue before exiting room.

Crumpled Parchment

"Tenants of Faith:

One. Honor our God, and his altars, with blood.

Two. Obey until you can usurp Listen to red and black robes.

Three. Only the strongest will survive.

Remember, neophytes are not allowed passed skulls in Great Hall."

Sound of bustling, chpping, shrill voice yelling, "Oi! stop yer wailin' and come serve this food, or I'll give you somethin' to cry about!" Large, glum Orc chopping meat with a huge cleaver. Sweaty hafling removing bread from oven. Trays of delicious food on table. Loud sobs from pantry.

  • Orc. @UUID[Actor.Jqy5vRRrnTOgKx06]{Cult Butcher}. Deep, gruff voice. Uses Meat's Back on the Menu and attacks PCs if not disguised.

  • Halfling. @UUID[Actor.5MOMM9lRyo8qVZR8]{Cult Baker}. Shrill voice. Feigns innocence, goes invisible and ambushes weakest PC at first opportunity. May try to hold villager hostage.

  • Food. Ready to be taken to Great Hall

  • Pantry

    • Villager. Sobbing loudly. Told to take food to Great Hall but is in shock.

    • 2 Red Robes. 1 large (butcher's), 1 small (baker's).

    • Supplies. Kegs of ale. Salted meats. Flour.

Sound of many voices laughing cruelly, punctuated by sharp cries of pain. Nine robed figures torment two scared villagers. Two skull statues (bloody handprints) by the east door.

  • Robed Figures

    • 6 @UUID[Actor.yguUZJ0iczCebi8e]{Cult Neophyte}

    • 3 @UUID[Actor.uExzKZRMjXZRrhnh]{Cult Acolyte}

  • Skull Statues

    • Trap. Unless place bloody hand on skull before opening east door, afflicted with Blood Lust.

    • Bloody Hand. 1 HP of blood, own or not

  • Blood Lust.

    • When afflicted, use next action to attack the nearest creature (with ADV), or take 1d4 damage.

  • Moving Through Hall

    • Brazenly. Bultist accost PCs right away

    • Sneak. DC 12 DEX (9 if cultist distracted) each round in hall. If more PCs fail than succeed, or if any roll Nat 1's, they're noticed.

    • Drugged. Cultist asleep if fed sleep potion

    • Neophyte Disguise. Only questioned going through east door (neophytes not permitted entry).

    • Acolyte Disguise. Only questioned if trigger Skull Statue trap at east door.

    • Master Disguise. Not questioned.

Sound of clinking chains, dripping water. Four villagers huddled in squalid cell. Cell door locked, but bars look rusted and brittle.

  • If captured (once only). PCs wake up in cell with no gear, unless it was concealed. Gear stored in Halls of Pain

    • Rest (optional). PCs can rest here, but half of remaining captured villagers are sacrificed while PC's sleep.

  • Locked. Use Skull Key (Mistress of Pain), lockpick (DC 12 DEX), break bars (DC 12 STR, noisy).

  • Villagers. 4 @UUID[Actor.5wDTrsifhahwMDiH]{Strong Villager}, including Kara (elvish ancestry).

  • Kara. Will risk anything to rescue her betrothed, Tyrus, recently taken to Ritual Chamber

Sound of lashing whip, stifled grunts of pain, faint hissing. Drow Woman stands over older man that's strapped to table. Two red robed figures spectate gleefully. Equipment Storage, nor side of room.

  • Drow Woman is @UUID[Actor.fh3tkPui9VD7I4kF]{Mistress of Pain}

  • Red Robed Figures are @UUID[Actor.uExzKZRMjXZRrhnh]{Cult Acolyte}

  • Older Man is @UUID[Actor.81mxXvuC4Eri44bF]{Father Marcus}, priest of St. Terragnis. Injured

  • Strapped to Table. Can be freed with action.

  • Equipment Storage. Chainmail, mace (Father Marcus'), 5 daggers, PC gear (if captured)

No sound from within. Locked.

  • Locked. Use Skull Key (Mistress of Pain) or lockpick (DC 15 DEX)

When opened:

Sturdy wooden desk. Dusty bookshelf. Large feather bed.

  • Desk. Covered with papers and potions

    • Papers. Cult Orders

    • Potions. 3 healing potions (1d6 HP)

  • Bookshelf. Dusty books

    • 3 books are less dusty

      • 1. The Rule of Two: Now I am the Master

      • 2. Origin of Power

      • 3. Sanguine Sacrifices

    • If pull in order: 3, 1, 2 (Tenants of Faith) reveal secret tunnel to Bloodied Altar

    • If wrong order, tunnel sealed shut, and magic alarm blares (auto random encounter next turn, reroll 5+)

Cult Orders

Apostle Moloch,

I find your lack of progress disturbing.

Send a raiding party to Hillshire at first light. Convert the strongest amonth them and sacrifice the rest.

I grow tired of your excuses. Do not fail me again.

In His Bloody name,

Crimson Archon Ar-Zul

Sound of ominous chanting, led by deep, hypnotic-sounding voice. Locked.

  • Locked. Use Skull Key (Mistress of Pain) or lockpick (DC 15 DEX)

When opened:

1 black robed and 4 red robed figures chanting. 4 villagers are bound to wooden stakes. 5' deep river of caustic blood flows around outside of room.

  • Surprise. If come from Bloodied Altar cultists are surprised

  • Black Robed Leader @UUID[Actor.6VWM6Wb47guFI4p4]{Apostle Moloch}

  • Red Robed Figures. Acolytes. Eyes closed

Battle Tactics

  • Other cultists follow Moloch's orders or attack lowest HP enemy in near

  • Father Marcus fights, save heals for 0 HP allies

  • Kara will try to free Tyrus if plausible or talk him down if he's converted

  • If Tyrus or Kara is slain, the other will break free if converted or bound and fight to the death

  • Strong Villagers fight to the best of their ability

Moloch Tactics

  • Until attacked, uses Convert Unbeliever on bound villagers (Tyrus first) and frees them.

  • Once attacked, will use Convert Unbeliever on highest HP enemy not yet attempted. Only 1 PC can be converted at a time (strong wills are taxing to control)

  • Prioritizes killing low HP targets (including allies) to benefit from Bloodthirster

  • Uses Sanguine Grip to push/pull enemies into River of Blood or prone them before attacking

  • At dramatic moment, or when reduced to half HP, uses Darkness Falls

Massive Blood Drenched Skull. Pile of treasure at base of skull. Large mural covers walls.

  • Blood Drenched Skull. Titan's skull, covered in blood, bearing an ominous inscription

    • Inscription. "The strong take what they wish, but those who honor Him with the blood of the worthy slain, shall truly know His favor."

    • Blood God's Favor. Any PC offering a worthy sacrifice gains a Luck Token. Ramlaat will be watching their career with great interest…

    • Worth Sacrifice. Drenching the altar in the blood of a slain creature with 5+ max HP. PCs have a sense of who may be worthy. Villagers, especially Father marcus, disapprove.

    • Mural. Depicts scene of epic battle so bloody it drowns the world. Robed figures with demonit wings fly safely above the sanguine flood.

    • Treasure

      • 200 gold (3 XP)

      • @UUID[Compendium.shadowdark.magic-items.Item.t4RYKztP70zmAbGD]{Pearl of Power} (3 XP) A fat, opalescent pearl glowing with an inner radiance. Benefit. Once per day, you may regain the ability to cast a spell you have lost. This cannot restore a spell lost to a critical spellcasting failure.
Scent of fresh air. Reddish metallic stairs leading up t othe surface. A secret, well-concealed exit.
